cards.audioText: You are CSN319, parking at gate 51, with Information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方319，停在51号停机位，通播C，从武汉飞往广州，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方319，51号停机位，通播C，请求飞往广州的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1,200m, cruising level 9,800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO01离场。初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 9800m, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO01离场。初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, due to military activity, expect 1hour delay, you are No.5 in sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，由于军事活动，预计有1小时延误，你是第五个。

cards.audioText: You are now ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在准备好推出开车了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN319, request pushback and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方319，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN319, after B737 behind is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，与后方B737解除冲突后，在Z4推出，正切213号停机位，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: After B737 is clear, pushback onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与后方B737解除冲突后，在Z4推出，正切213号停机位，面朝东，南方319。

cards.audioText: You have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 你完成了推出开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方319，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN319, taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待，南方319。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for takeoff.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN319. Ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方319，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: CSN319, Behind B737, line up behind, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，在B737后，上跑道等待，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Behind B737, line up behind, runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在B737后，上跑道等待，跑道36右，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, climb to 3,900m, expedite until passing 2,100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，爬升到3900米，加速爬升至2100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到3900米，加速爬升至2100米，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, stop climbing due converging traffic, level off at 2,700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，由于汇入航空器，停止爬升，在2700米改平。
cards.referenceText: level off at 2700m due converging traffic, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于汇入航空器，在2700米改平，南方319。

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3,900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现，你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，告诉管制员这个情况，并请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN319, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3,900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，南方319，我们一个液压失效，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: Roger PAN, maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach r/w 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到PAN，保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右，南方319。

cards.audioText: Thunderstorm was detected near LKO, ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: 在LKO探测到雷暴，请求左偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN319, request deviate 20miles to the left due to thunderstorm near LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方319，由于LKO附近有雷暴，请求左偏航20海里。
